name: Haramimura - Tsuma wa Mura no Mono
original_name: 孕み村 妻は村の共有財産
source:
Haruki” and his wife ‘Nagisa’ go to a hospital in Tokyo for fertility treatment. They are told that there is a village known for helping in improving fertility.

The village was rich in nature and seemed to be the best place for them to heal their minds and bodies. There was a rumor that they would be blessed with a child, so they moved to the village and started their new life.

A few days passed after the move, and Haruki had returned to work, Nagisa was asked by the village chief to help him with the cleaning, so she went to the chief's mansion alone.

When she was taking a break from cleaning, the village chief sexually harassed her about having a baby, and when she was about to leave, he kissed her forcefully and raped her.

The reason this village is so fertile is because the women who live here are raped and impregnated by the whole village!

Will Nagisa be able to safely give birth to her husband's child?

[From [url=http://www.sc-crg.com/haramimura/#story]official site[/url]]
